description.value: The Logan Lake Municipal Campground is a 50-site lakeview facility operated by the District of Logan Lake, offering both powered RV sites and tent-only sites. Amenities include hot showers, free WiFi, potable water taps throughout the grounds, a fish cleaning station, and a boat launch on the lake. A bike park, mountain bike and hiking trails, two disc golf courses, and a golf course are all within walking distance.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A municipally operated campground with hot showers, potable water, free WiFi, and a bike park within walking distance—a strong overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan–Thompson region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground also offers a discount at the adjacent golf course for registered campers. Shoulder-season operation (post-Thanksgiving to April) limits amenities to powered sites only.
